long_description:
Access meaningful insight from your subconscious memory field. No experience is necessary.

 Past Life Memories don't come from your mind ... they come from your Soul ... they lead you to familiar people, places, and emotions. You don't "think' them ... You FEEL them

 Please bring a yoga mat, pillow and blanket for your comfort for this session if you prefer to lay down and also a pen and paper. If you prefer to sit in a chair for the session, chairs will be provided. Eye masks will be provided to all in person attendees.

 Register for your spot at: https://carella.mykajabi.com/offers/xmnY86y2/checkout

 Registration Fee: $44
 Location: Carella Shoes, 2431 Nottingham Way, Hamilton, NJ 08619 

 “My guided past life regression was life changing, honestly. To see my experiences I’ve lived in the past has helped me re-shape my present moments and how I’ve handled situations versus how I handle situations now. It truly changed my life and I will always recommend not only experiencing it yourself but, experiencing it personally with Michelle. A million thank you’s to an amazing woman.” – Kate M.

 Experience being guided in this healing journey in to your past/parallel life where you will explore lessons learned and unlearned, life experiences that are still resonating with you in this life, and discover relationships with friends and family members who have traveled with you before in other lives.

 Gain insights in to your preferences and relationships that can help you heal repeating challenges that you are facing in your current life.

 Attendees will receive a brief overview of what a past life regression really is and the many ways your soul’s communication with you can help you to create a happier, more fulfilling and abundant life.

 The specially designed guided meditation will reconnect you with information stored in your soul memories in a safe, peaceful, and loving space, and help you move forward more fully towards your maximum potential.
